speaker: (the hired man)
text: It is not this one. I have had three that begin with a twin, and none of them is the twin I am.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Stay in the chest. The roll is here. Sixty went into the chest, and a roll does not leave a chest by itself.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Left side, under the oiled cloth. Not the loose three on the top. The top is Friday and Saturday. Sunday is the old book. Do not crown a man out of Friday.

speaker: (the hired man)
text: This one says a duke. I am not a duke tonight.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Then it is not yours. Put it back where your hand found it. A wrong roll left out is how a company plays two plays and calls it one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Look at the head of the next. If it begins with a servant, keep it. If it begins with a father, give it back. I have already been the father. I am not being him again from a chest.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: He gave the tale at the start. He is not giving it again out of my lid. I want a man who can read a title. I do not want a speech about anyone's nerves.

speaker: (the hired man)
text: I can read a title. I have read three. I will read a fourth if the fourth is mine.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Fourth, then. Under your thumb. Not the one with Friday's paper crown written at the head. That crown is a different night.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Small courtesy, and then back. They are laughing at a thing that is already made. Do not improve it from this side of the cloth.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Here. The servant, the second act, the old hand. Take it. Do not roll it tighter than it was. The ink cracks if you love it too hard.

speaker: (the hired man)
text: This is the one. I know the first word. I do not need to say the first word aloud to know it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then do not say it aloud. Go on when they look for you, and not before. I am not your prompter. I am the man who did not want a lost roll on top of a long tale.

speaker: george_bryan
text: You have the roll. Be off the chest. He is not going to practise a fear in front of you, and you are not going to wait about until he does.

speaker: (the hired man)
text: I have it. Thank you, sir. I will not bring you the wrong twin again.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: See that you do not. Sixty is a number I can still count. I do not mean to count it twice because a man was in a hurry.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Count them in the morning if you must. Tonight the second act can spare me, and it cannot spare him with the wrong paper.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The laugh out there is a good laugh. It is not asking you for a new line. Leave it where it is.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: The chest shuts. Friday and Saturday stay on the top, where I put them. Sunday goes back in when he is done, and not into a basket by mistake.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not writing a better Egeon while they laugh. I was younger. The tale can bear being younger.

speaker: (the hired man)
text: I am on. I have the right roll.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Then be on. We are not a procession behind a cloth.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Off the chest when he is gone. I like a lid that has been shut by a hand and not by a hope.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It shuts. I am where I was. Behind the cloth, and quiet.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Quiet is the courtesy. Keep it.
